aiDescription.summary: The bill directs FEMA, within 120 days, to revise 44 C.F.R. §206.48 to apply fixed weighted criteria for Public Assistance (10/40/10/10/10/10/10: cost; localized impacts; insurance; mitigation; recent disasters; other Federal aid; economic) and Individual Assistance (20/20/20/10/20/5/5: concentration; trauma; special populations; voluntary agencies; insurance; state average aid; economic). It applies to Governors’ requests for Stafford Act major disaster declarations denied on or after January 1, 2012.

description.text: Fairness in Federal Disaster Declarations Act of 2026

impact.summary: FEMA's Administrator must amend 44 C.F.R. §206.48 within 120 days to assign weights when evaluating Public Assistance (localized impacts 40%, cost 10%) and Individual Assistance (damage concentration 20%, trauma 20%, insurance 20%). The change alters how FEMA decides Governors' Stafford Act requests and affects states, localities, survivors, voluntary agencies, and insurers for disasters denied on or after January 1, 2012.

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs. (text: CR S652-653)
